anomalies.description: Armed individuals engage in close-quarters combat; one figure in a white cap and bandana swings a weapon while others grapple and move aggressively in a cluttered indoor space.
A man with blood on his face holds a rifle in a ready position, aiming forward; another person is beside him, suggesting active engagement or imminent gunfire.
A man shoulders a rocket-propelled grenade (RPG) launcher and aims it down a corridor, with visible recoil posture and targeting stance.
A large, bright yellow-orange explosion erupts from a doorway, producing intense light, sparks, and debris; the blast wave and fireball dominate the frame.
A large, bright explosion with intense sparks and debris erupts from a wall opening, engulfing the scene in yellow-orange light and smoke; visible across multiple frames as the blast propagates.
A bright flash and shower of sparks erupt from the RPG impact point, indicating detonation of the warhead; debris and light fill the frame.
Two individuals are engaged in close-quarters physical combat amid the explosion’s aftermath; one appears to be striking or grappling the other while both are airborne or recoiling from the blast.

A group of armed individuals moves aggressively through a damaged interior; their coordinated movement, weapons, and tense postures suggest collective violent unrest or armed clash, not mere presence.
A man with facial injuries is actively aiming and firing a rifle; muzzle flash or weapon discharge is implied by his posture, grip, and focused aim, consistent with active shooting.
